title: Tool error not recovered: patch_file on .moeb/README.md
description: patch_file failed twice on .moeb/README.md with 'error applying hunk #1. All context lines appear in the file — check that the removed lines (-) exactly match the file content, and that no duplicate context block is selecting the wrong hunk.' The operation was eventually completed on a third attempt with an explicit line-number hunk header (@@ -214,6 +214,7 @@). Both failures were recorded in RunState.tool_errors.
proposed_resolution: Investigate why patch_file failed and whether the intended operation completed. If a file write was not applied, a write_file fallback or retry is required before the next run succeeds.
